result.summary: The page is largely well-composed, but the bottom navigation bar is overlapped by the system home-indicator bar, causing icons to be visually struck through. A couple of minor polish issues (unlabeled tab icons, low-contrast secondary text) were also noted. Carousel clipping and bottom-cut cards were treated as intended behavior.

issues.description: The horizontal home-indicator bar sits directly on top of the bottom tab bar, drawing a black line through the search and orders/receipt icons and leaving the tab bar with no bottom safe-area padding.
issues.suggestion: Add safe-area-inset-bottom padding to the tab bar so icons and labels sit above the home indicator, and increase the bar's height accordingly.

issues.description: Bottom navigation items are icon-only with no visible text labels, making their purpose (home, search, orders, profile) ambiguous and harder to identify.
issues.suggestion: Add short text labels under each tab icon (or at minimum ensure descriptive accessibility labels are provided).

issues.description: Secondary metadata text such as '€0.90 delivery' and the '25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen' line uses a light gray that appears close to the minimum contrast threshold on white.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text color slightly to comfortably meet WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1) for small text.
